newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures close firm, further gains expected.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures close firm, further gains expected.

text.p: FCOJ futures settled firmer amid follow-through fund and speculative buying that bolstered the benchmark September contract to a three-week high, trading sources said.
The most-active month pierced resistance at 76.00 cents and then at 77.00 cents.
The buying carried September to the day's high of 77.50 cents, its strongest level since reaching 78.25 cents on July 7, before closing at 77.15 cents, up 1.80 cents.
The rest of the board ended 0.55 to 1.80 firmer.

Analysts viewed today's close well above 76.00 cents, where a double top formed basis the September contract on July 10 and July 15, as a bullish technical sign that prices are likely to climb higher.
"It looks very strong," a broker said.
She pegged resistance over the recent high at 80.00 cents basis September.
An estimated 4,500 lots changed hands on the day, compared with Monday's official 2,169 lots.
Near-term support remained at 74.00 cents followed by 73.50 cents in September.
